channel.title: Oskar Wichtowski - Articles
channel.description: Articles on AI engineering, LLM integrations, serverless architecture, and quality assurance by Oskar Wichtowski.

item.title: Testing AI Services at Scale with Playwright - A Practical Guide
item.description: How we built a layered integration testing strategy for a multi-service AI platform using Playwright's API testing, contract-driven test data from S3, evaluation metrics with percentage failure thresholds, and a Friday-to-Monday batched indexing verification workflow.

item.title: Serverless Is a Lie and We All Just Agreed to Pretend
item.description: A rant about how 'serverless' still runs on servers - they're just someone else's servers, and you're still paying for them.

item.title: How We Indexed Over 300,000 Scientific Papers with a Serverless AI Pipeline
item.description: How we rebuilt a serverless AI pipeline for indexing 300,000+ scientific papers - with OCR, chunking, figure enrichment, embeddings, retries, and cost-aware re-indexing.
